agentGuidance.purpose: Review on screen: an always-on-top overlay for drawings, text notes, voice pins, clean screenshots, and multi-frame visual feedback, returned to the session.
agentGuidance.when: The user should mark up what they see: pointing at UI regions, annotating a design or page visually, or giving multi-frame feedback that words describe poorly.
agentGuidance.recipe: Invoke overlay.review.launch (or open the overlay-review application); collected annotations, notes, and frames come back as the result for you to act on.
agentGuidance.boundaries: Interactive and user-facing: launch it when the user wants to annotate, not to capture their screen unprompted. No MCP tools; not a standalone app.
